config.bbsf.title: Better Block Sounds Fork
config.bbsf.rules.description: Rules apply in order. The last matching rule wins.
config.bbsf.rule_list.description: Format: #namespace:tag=sound_type or namespace:block=sound_type. Add, delete or reorder rules here.
message.bbsf.reloaded: Better Block Sounds Fork: sound configuration reloaded.
config.bbsf.type_list.description: Add, rename or delete sound types. New definitions copy stone_ore; save and reopen this screen to edit their events. Remove or update rules that reference deleted IDs.
config.bbsf.block_preview.tooltip: Blocks using configured sound types. Includes blocks from tags, with their item icons and names in the client language. Reopen after changing rules.
config.bbsf.block_preview.empty: No matching blocks found. World or datapack tags may not be loaded yet.
config.bbsf.block_preview.entry: Rule: %s. Sound type: %s. This list is read-only; edit rules in the Block rules tab.
